description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in precision as a function of the number of tokens used in a KV cache compression algorithm. The x-axis represents different layers of a neural network, ranging from Layer1-4 to Layer29-32. The y-axis measures the relative change in precision, with values ranging from -15% to 5%.
